control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: trapped hazardous energy found after isolation of SG-9000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on SG-9000 and TX-9001 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. SG-9000 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 8 November 2019 a potential incident was recorded on SG-9000 and TX-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
